name: doc_parsing
description: Reads a provided .docx document and converts its contents into a Markdown string for the LLM to read, analyze, and extract BUA data.

inputs.name: file_path
inputs.description: The absolute or relative path to the uploaded .docx document that needs to be read.

outputs.description: A dictionary containing the 'status', a system 'message', and the extracted 'document_text' as a markdown string.

output.message: Document successfully read. Please extract the BUA data from the following markdown text and save it to the state using your questionnaire_parsing tool.
output.document_text:
## Document: bua_draft_submission

**Project Title:** Viral Vector Engineering
**Principal Investigator:** Dr. Elena Rostova...
